response.sql: SELECT AVG(type_avg_quantity) as avg_product_quantity, AVG(type_avg_num_items) as avg_order_items_count, AVG(type_avg_share) as avg_order_items_share FROM (SELECT AVG(prod.avg_quantity) as type_avg_quantity, AVG(prod.num_order_items) as type_avg_num_items, AVG(prod.share) as type_avg_share FROM (SELECT p.product_id, p.production_type_code, AVG(CAST(oi.product_quantity AS DECIMAL(19,4))) as avg_quantity, COUNT(oi.order_item_id) as num_order_items, COUNT(oi.order_item_id) * 1.0 / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Order_Items), 0) as share FROM Products p LEFT JOIN Order_Items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id, p.production_type_code) prod GROUP BY prod.production_type_code) by_type
